previous_evidence.excerpt: During onboarding someone made a joke about Eastern European work ethic — meant as a compliment, apparently. Tomasz laughed it off. I didn't say anything.

current_evidence.excerpt: Had a one-on-one with my manager Katharina. She asked how I was finding the team culture and I actually said something. Told her the comment during Tomasz's onboarding bothered me and that I think we could be more careful about...

Grocery run after work. Standing in Edeka staring at the coffee shelf. Fair trade option is almost double the price of the store brand. I know what the price difference means — it means someone down the supply chain is...
Can't sleep. Keep thinking about how easily I let things go at work. Tomasz caught my eye in the hallway today and just nodded and I felt like a fraud.
